title: Ztracený deštník
desc: Mia hledá svůj deštník po celém domě. Najde ho venku — na hlavě kocoura.
desc_en: Mia searches the whole house for her umbrella and finds it outside, on a cat's head.
world: a cozy small town on a rainy spring day, cobblestone street, warm glowing shop windows, puddles
setting: Útulné městečko v deštivém jarním dni: dlážděná ulice, kaluže a teple svítící výlohy.
music: gentle playful children's music, ukulele, glockenspiel and soft pizzicato strings, light rainy mood, warm and happy, instrumental, 90 bpm

mia.name: Mia
mia.desc: a cheerful 7-year-old girl with a short black bob haircut and big brown eyes, wearing a bright yellow raincoat and red rubber boots
mia.look: Veselá sedmiletá holčička s černým mikádem a velkýma hnědýma očima, ve žluté pláštěnce a červených holínkách.

cat.name: kocour Mourek
cat.desc: a chubby fluffy grey tabby cat with round green eyes and a white chest
cat.look: Baculatý chlupatý šedý mourovatý kocour s kulatýma zelenýma očima a bílou náprsenkou.

shots.action: Mia klečí na parapetu v pokojíčku a dívá se na déšť. Přitiskne nos na sklo, orosí ho dechem, pak se opře a usměje.
shots.keyframe: Mia kneels on the window seat in her cozy bedroom and looks out at the rain on the window glass
shots.motion: Mia presses her nose to the rainy window glass, her breath fogs it, then she leans back and smiles
shots.narration: Pršelo. Mia se na déšť moc těšila.
shots.narration_en: It was raining. Mia loved rainy days.

shots.action: V předsíni stojí prázdný stojan na deštníky. Mia vyjekne a chytí se za tváře.
shots.keyframe: Mia stands in the hallway next to an empty umbrella stand, both hands on her cheeks, surprised
shots.motion: Mia looks at the empty umbrella stand, gasps with wide eyes and puts both hands on her cheeks, then stays still
shots.narration: Jenže stojan na deštníky byl prázdný!
shots.narration_en: But the umbrella stand was empty!

shots.action: Mia leží na břiše a svítí baterkou pod postel. Pak si sedne, zavrtí hlavou a pokrčí rameny.
shots.keyframe: Mia lies on her tummy on the bedroom floor and looks under her bed with a small flashlight
motion: Mia shines the flashlight under the bed and moves it slowly from side to side, then pulls her head back out
Mia sits up on the floor, shakes her head and shrugs with both hands, then sits still
shots.narration: Hledala pod postelí. Byl tam jen míček a jedna ponožka.
shots.narration_en: She looked under the bed. Only a ball and one sock.

shots.action: Mia otevře velkou dřevěnou skříň, nakoukne mezi kabáty a zase ji zavře.
shots.keyframe: Mia opens a big wooden wardrobe full of coats and peeks inside
shots.motion: Mia pulls the wardrobe door open, peeks inside between the coats, then closes the door again
shots.narration: Ve skříni byly kabáty, ale deštník ne.
shots.narration_en: The wardrobe had coats, but no umbrella.

shots.action: V kuchyni Mia nadzvedne velkou konvici, podívá se za ni a vzdychne.
shots.keyframe: Mia in a bright kitchen looks behind a big teapot on the table
shots.motion: Mia lifts the teapot a little, looks behind it, puts it back down and sighs
shots.narration: V kuchyni voněl čaj. Deštník nikde.
shots.narration_en: The kitchen smelled of tea. No umbrella.

shots.action: Mia vyjde z domu na deštivou ulici bez deštníku, natáhne si kapuci a kouká do nebe.
shots.keyframe: Mia steps out of the front door onto the rainy street without an umbrella, raindrops on her hood
shots.motion: Mia steps out of the door, pulls her yellow hood up and looks up at the falling rain
shots.narration: Tak vyšla ven jen v pláštěnce.
shots.narration_en: So she went out in just her raincoat.

shots.action: Mia skáče do velké kaluže a voda stříká kolem červených holínek. Skočí ještě jednou a hihňá se.
shots.keyframe: Mia jumps into a big puddle on the cobblestone street, water splashing around her red boots
motion: Mia jumps into the puddle with both feet, water splashes up around her red boots and she laughs
Mia jumps once more into the same puddle, water splashes, then she stands still and giggles
shots.narration: Kaluže! Mia skákala, až voda stříkala na všechny strany.
shots.narration_en: Puddles! Mia jumped and water splashed everywhere.

shots.action: Na nízkém plotě sedí kocour Mourek s Miiným červeným deštníkem na hlavě jako s kloboukem. Deštník se kýve, Mia na něj ukazuje a směje se.
shots.keyframe: Tom the cat sits on a low garden fence wearing Mia's small red umbrella on his head like a hat, Mia stands below and looks up at him
shots.motion: the cat on the fence tilts his head, the red umbrella on his head wobbles, Mia points up at him and laughs
shots.narration: Na plotě seděl kocour Mourek. S jejím deštníkem!
shots.narration_en: On the fence sat Tom. With her umbrella!

shots.action: Mia na mokré ulici před plotem tančí kuřecí tanec: mává lokty jako křídly, podřepne a tleská.
shots.keyframe: Mia stands on the wet street in front of a garden fence, laughing, ready to dance
shots.motion: Mia dances the chicken dance on the spot, flapping her elbows like wings, wiggling down and clapping her hands, same yellow raincoat, same street
shots.narration: Mia se tak smála, že začala tancovat kuřecí tanec. Mourek jen koukal.
shots.narration_en: Mia laughed so hard she did the chicken dance. Tom just stared.

shots.action: Mourek packou dostrká deštník k Mie. Mia ho zvedne a otevře.
shots.keyframe: Tom the cat sits on the pavement and pushes the red umbrella towards Mia with his paw
shots.motion: the cat pushes the red umbrella towards Mia with his paw, Mia picks it up and opens it
shots.narration: Mourek jí deštník vrátil. Hodný kocour.
shots.narration_en: Tom gave the umbrella back. What a kind cat.

shots.action: Mia a Mourek sedí na lavičce pod otevřeným červeným deštníkem. Kocour se přitulí a Mia ho hladí.
shots.keyframe: Mia and Tom the cat sit together on a bench under the open red umbrella while rain falls around them
shots.motion: rain falls around the umbrella, the cat snuggles closer to Mia, Mia strokes his head and smiles
shots.narration: Pod deštníkem bylo místo pro oba.
shots.narration_en: There was room for both under the umbrella.

shots.action: Mia jde s deštníkem ulicí ke kameře, Mourek cupitá vedle ní. Déšť ustane a nad střechami svítí duha.
shots.keyframe: Mia and Tom the cat walk home down the street under the red umbrella, a big rainbow in the sky above the roofs
shots.motion: Mia walks towards the camera holding the red umbrella, the cat trots beside her, the rain stops and the rainbow shines
shots.narration: Déšť přestal a nad městem svítila duha.
shots.narration_en: The rain stopped and a rainbow shone over town.
